_comment: Product-discovery set: do assistants recommend Steady when people ask for an app? Question set is FROZEN for longitudinal comparison: editing, rewording, reordering or removing a question breaks comparison with every earlier snapshot. To ask something new, add a new item at the end and note the date it was added. Write snapshots to PRESENCE_DIR=presence/discovery, never to presence/ (exp1 history). See docs/discovery-probe.md.
_itemsNote: The ladder asks only questions[0] of each item, so there is one item per question. Items share a pageUrl on purpose: R3 (verbatim) runs once per page, R4 once per question. procedureSlug is empty on purpose, so R2 is skipped. pageUrl decides which page is checked for liveness and R3; citation of ANY growsteady.me URL counts at R4. /recovery holds the questions whose honest answer is the free calculator; /about holds the 'which app' questions.
